items.source: FieldNamingStrategy that abbreviates field names by using the very first letter of the camel case parts of the PersistentProperty's name.
items.translation: FieldNamingStrategy 通过使用 PersistentProperty 名称中驼峰式各部分的首字母来缩写字段名称。

items.source: FieldNamingStrategy simply using the PersistentProperty's name.
items.translation: FieldNamingStrategy 仅使用 PersistentProperty 的名称。

items.source: Configurable FieldNamingStrategy that splits up camel-case property names and reconcatenates them using a configured delimiter.
items.translation: 可配置的FieldNamingStrategy，用于拆分驼峰式属性名并使用配置的分隔符重新连接它们。

items.source: FieldNamingStrategy that translates typical camel case Java property names to lower case JSON element names, separated by underscores.
items.translation: FieldNamingStrategy，用于将典型的驼峰式 Java 属性名转换为由下划线分隔的小写 JSON 元素名称。

items.source: Core implementation of the mapping subsystem's model.
items.translation: 映射子系统模型的核心实现。

items.source: Uses of FieldNamingStrategy in org.springframework.data.mapping.model
items.translation: FieldNamingStrategy 在 org.springframework.data.mapping.model 中的用途
